scripts.android: if [ ! -d "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" ]; then echo '❌ Android SDK não encontrado!'; echo ''; echo '📱 Para compilar o app Android, você precisa:'; echo '1. Instalar o Android Studio: https://developer.android.com/studio'; echo '2. Abrir o Android Studio e ir em: More Actions > SDK Manager'; echo '3. Instalar o Android SDK (recomendado: API 34)'; echo '4. Depois execute novamente: npm run android'; exit 1; fi && export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17/bin:$PATH" && export JAVA_HOME="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17" && export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" && cd android && ./gradlew installDebug
scripts.build:android: npm run build:android:bundle && npm run build:android:apk
scripts.build:android:bundle: rm -rf android/app/build/generated/assets/createBundleReleaseJsAndAssets && mkdir -p android/app/build/generated/assets/createBundleReleaseJsAndAssets && npx metro build index.js --platform android --out android/app/build/generated/assets/createBundleReleaseJsAndAssets/index.android.bundle --minify false && mv android/app/build/generated/assets/createBundleReleaseJsAndAssets/index.android.bundle.js android/app/build/generated/assets/createBundleReleaseJsAndAssets/index.android.bundle 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build:android:apk: cd android && export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17/bin:$PATH" && export JAVA_HOME="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17" && export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.deploy:android: npm run build:android && npm run install:android && export PATH="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools:$PATH" && adb shell "am start -n com.auricapri/.MainActivity" && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ~/Desktop/Auricapri-Release.apk && echo "✅ App compilado, instalado e iniciado! APK salvo em ~/Desktop/Auricapri-Release.apk"
